cues.en: Reactivity is a core concept in svelte or put.
In other words, svelte is all about reactivity, and reactivity simply means that when you change something
in your JavaScript code, when a new value gets stored, when a user clicked a button and some code
runs and stores the name of the user in a variable that if you then output that data in the markup in
your HTML code, that svelte automatically updates the Dom.
That's the whole idea of using svelte in the end.
Right now, when we talk about reactivity, we talk about things like handling events, we talk about
things like updating data, and especially when we work with arrays and objects, this can be tricky.
This module is there to dive a bit deeper into these more advanced cases or the specific things and
special things you should be aware of.
